question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**insight**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage highlights a moment of reflection and realization that the character experiences as he falls asleep.
 
• “**Insight**” is the most appropriate choice because it refers to a clear understanding of a complex situation or a deep perception that the character is experiencing.
 
• Other options like “implication,” “insurance,” and “instance” do not fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage:* He looks out of the window at the (1)* *falling__* *snow, then turns and takes his wife in his arms, feeling grateful to be here even as he wonders what he is going to do with his life in strictly practical terms. For years, he had (2)* *__trained__** himself to do one thing, and he did it well, but he doesn't know whether he wants to keep doing it for the rest of his life, for that matter, whether anyone will let him. He is still worrying when they go to bed.*

*They've been learning to get by with less, and they'll keep learning. It seems to him as if they're taking a course in loss lately. And as he feels himself falling asleep he has an (3)* *__insight__* *he believes is important, which he hopes he will remember in the morning, although it is one of those thoughts that seldom (4) survives translation to the language of daylight hours.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• “**Insight**” (अंतर्दृष्टि) : Correct as it implies a deep understanding or realization.
 
• “**Implication**” (निहितार्थ) : Incorrect as it refers to a conclusion drawn from something but lacks the reflective element.
 
• “**Insurance**” (बीमा) : Incorrect as it refers to financial protection and is unrelated to the context.
 
• “**Instance**” (उदाहरण) : Incorrect as it means an example or occurrence and does not convey a deep realization.
